rows.definition: Constructor error sentinel in internal/compute/graph_cache_policy.go returned by NewGraphCachePolicy when a nonempty Voters slice contains a nil callback. Validation follows engine, capacity and minimum-retention checks and rejects the policy before any capture or replay. An absent or empty voter slice remains valid single-rank agreement.
rows.distinction: This reports an invalid graph-capture agreement callback configuration, not CachePolicyStream offline replay input data, a negative runtime rank vote, nil engine, invalid capacity or retention bounds, or a capture/replay engine failure. A non-nil callback returning false is valid and selects eager execution on a cache miss. Callback presence proves neither rank reachability nor hardware consensus.
